source_text: Critics of this view, including bodies like the WHO, maintain a distinction based on harm severity, noting FGC's absence of benefits and higher morbidity (e.g., up to 15% immediate complication rates in some settings) compared to male circumcision's debated advantages, such as a 60% reduction in heterosexual HIV acquisition in randomized trials from high-prevalence areas. [126] [128]
